name: Helisson Faoro
title: Public Health Researcher
bio: PhD in Biochemistry from UFPR, with postdoctoral research at the same institution. He is currently a Public Health Researcher at the Carlos Chagas Institute – Fiocruz Paraná, where he coordinates the Graduate Program in Biosciences and Biotechnology. His experience includes pathogen genomics, antimicrobial resistance, metagenomics, and bioinformatics. He is a member of AB3C and the British Society for Antimicrobial Chemotherapy.

projects.title: Investigation of carbapenem antibiotic resistance in Acinetobacter baumannii through genomic sequencing and genome-wide association study (GWAS)
projects.description: Use of GWAS to identify molecular resistance markers in A. baumannii and develop predictive models.

projects.title: Multi-omics analysis of polymyxin-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii
projects.description: Molecular characterization of resistant strains using genome, transcriptome, proteome, and lipidome to build a metabolic model.

projects.title: Investigation of resistance mechanisms in Klebsiella pneumoniae using multi-omics methodology
projects.description: Integrated study of genome, transcriptome, and proteome to understand antibiotic resistance.

name: Hellen Geremias Gatica Santos
title: Public Health Researcher
bio: PhD in Epidemiology from USP, with ongoing postdoctoral studies in Statistics (USP/UFSCar). She is currently a Public Health Researcher at the Carlos Chagas Institute, working in statistics applied to biological and genomic data. She has experience in machine learning, sequencing data analysis (WES, WGS), and genome-wide association studies. She is a member of the Regional Council of Statistics (CONRE-3).

projects.title: Knockoff filter for selection of genetic variants in complex phenotypes
projects.description: Comparison of different knockoff generators and variable selection methods in genomic data.

projects.title: NAPI Precision Public Health
projects.description: Research arrangement to demonstrate the viability of genetic diagnoses (WGS) in the SUS, focusing on rare diseases.

projects.title: Statistical methods for genomic data
projects.description: Development of variant collapsing techniques, Bayesian selection, and network construction.

name: Fabio Passetti
title: Principal Public Health Researcher
bio: PhD in Bioinformatics from USP. Principal Researcher at Fiocruz, CNPq productivity fellow (Level 2). He coordinates the Center for Precision Public Health and the next-generation sequencing platform (Illumina NovaSeq 6000). He works in proteogenomics, integrated analysis of omics data, and is coordinator of the Genomas SUS project.

projects.title: Genomes SUS
projects.description: Sequencing of 21,000 complete genomes of Brazilians to characterize genetic mechanisms of priority diseases for the SUS.

projects.title: NAPI Precision Public Health
projects.description: Coordination of the arrangement for implementing WGS of patients from Paraná with rare diseases.

projects.title: Study of the impact of transcript diversity on the proteome of different brain regions
projects.description: Identification of orthologous proteoforms in human and murine brains with Alzheimer's Disease.
